purpose: After Gate009 stopped the standalone shape-gain compression lane, test whether the surviving adaptive clipping effect transfers from post-layer residual hooks to the actual BitLinear activation-quantization sites of the official packed BitNet b1.58 model.

frozen_protocol.calibration_transfer: WikiText validation only; frozen unchanged for C4
frozen_protocol.data_construction: Same token construction and offsets as Gates006-009; use the same first 16 sequences of each previously frozen 32-sequence evaluation tensor.

site_definition: Patch transformers.integrations.bitnet.BitLinear.activation_quant. The patched quantizer receives exactly the tensor that the native BitLinear forward would quantize, after any module-local RMSNorm. Packed ternary weights and all other model operations remain unchanged.

adaptive_quantizer.calibration: For each BitLinear independently, on frozen WikiText validation calibration tokens, find the MSE-minimizing clip c among 13 fractions of that token's absmax under signed A4 reconstruction. Build a 16-entry absolute clip codebook from quantiles 0.005..0.995 of those token-optimal c values.
adaptive_quantizer.runtime: For each token and BitLinear independently, choose the frozen codebook entry minimizing activation reconstruction MSE; return signed INT4-equivalent integer codes -8..7 plus scale=7/c. Selection uses only the current activation tensor, never labels, logits, downstream loss, or evaluation-corpus tuning.
adaptive_quantizer.decoder_reconstructible: The selected clip is identified by a 4-bit codebook index; the 16-entry codebook is fixed per BitLinear from calibration.

primary_rules.adaptive_beats_dynamic: On each corpus, adaptive-codebook A4 mean NLL < dynamic-absmax A4 mean NLL and the paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI of per-sequence adaptive-minus-dynamic NLL is < 0.
primary_rules.absolute_viability: On each corpus, adaptive-codebook A4 NLL <= native A8 NLL + 0.50.
primary_rules.robust_pass: Both rules pass on both corpora and native A8 parity to the previously frozen native model is within 1e-5 where directly comparable.

interpretation_boundary.pass: Adaptive clipping/range selection survives at the true BitLinear activation-quantization sites and merits larger/task-level evaluation. This does not establish speed, energy, kernel efficiency, or novelty over adaptive quantization generally.
interpretation_boundary.fail: Stop the residual-hook-derived adaptive-A4 method lane; retain Gates006-009 only as a representation/diagnostic result.
interpretation_boundary.shape_gain: Gate009 remains binding. Do not reopen the separately coded radius/shape-gain compression method regardless of Gate010 outcome.

literature_boundary: BitNet b1.58 official packed model is natively W1.58A8 with per-token absmax activation quantization.
BitNet v2 already establishes Hadamard-based native A4 for 1-bit LLMs.
TWLA already establishes W1.58A4 PTQ with learned orthogonal shaping and mixed precision.

FPTQuant, DynamicPTQ, InfoQuant, MXFP/AdaMX and related work establish broad activation shaping, dynamic scaling, residual sensitivity, and adaptive low-bit quantization; Gate010 is a transfer/viability test, not a broad novelty claim.
